archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for High-Performance Mentoring
global_vibe: Moderno e ousado (Modern and bold), authoritative, premium, and focused on hyper-growth.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid (Marketing Pages) and Control Room Grid (Dashboard)
layout_and_spacing.radius: rounded-2xl for large marketing blocks, rounded-lg for dashboard widgets
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Optical alignment prioritized. Avoid center-everything default; use strong left-alignments for tension.

chat_interface.style: Minimalist, no borders on main chat, stark contrast
chat_interface.user_bubble: bg-[#FF4500]/10 border border-[#FF4500]/30 text-white rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm p-4
chat_interface.input_area: bg-[#141414] border border-[#27272A] rounded-full px-6 py-4 focus-within:border-[#FF4500] focus-within:ring-1 focus-within:ring-[#FF4500] flex items-center gap-3

learning_tracks.style: Bento-style Glassmorphism cards with sharp inner borders
learning_tracks.classes: bg-[#141414]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6 hover:border-[#FF4500]/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer group relative overflow-hidden
learning_tracks.image_treatment: Images inside tracks should have max overlay opacity bg-black/50 or subtle gradients to preserve image visibility while keeping text readable.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF4500] text-white font-bold rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-[#E03E00] hover:scale-105 transition-all shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,69,0,0.3)] flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-white/20 rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2

navigation.style: Crystal Glass sticky header. bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10

images_and_media.description: Abstract neon orange and purple streaks on dark background for the landing page hero section.
Glowing blue abstract sphere on black, representing the AI mentor entity in the chat.
Digital marketing track cover image. Screen with metrics.
Network nodes illustrating digital connections and affiliation networks.

accessibility_and_motion.animations: Use Framer Motion for page transitions, stagger children in the learning tracks grid. Buttons should have micro-interactions (scale-105 on hover).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use @phosphor-icons/react for sharp, high-end dashboard icons (Duotone or Regular weight).
Since we use .js and not .tsx, ensure all React components are written in standard JSX/JS syntax. Do not add TS types.
Implement the landing page with custom HTML/Tailwind for maximum creative freedom, using the 'hero_background' image overlay with bg-black/50.
For the AI Chat interface, use a 'Control Room' layout. The sidebar should be #141414 and the main chat area #0A0A0A.
The AI Mentor must support markdown rendering (use react-markdown) for Portuguese text, code, lists, and bold strategies.
Use Shadcn UI for the Auth flow, tabs, and modals, heavily overriding defaults to match the deep blacks and 1px #27272A borders.
Never use generic Vercel-style cards for the Dashboard; use Bento grid logic with wide gaps (gap-6 or gap-8) and bold visual tension.
Ensure all text is in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR). Use terms like 'Mentoria', 'Trilhas de Aprendizado', 'Indicações'.
Strictly follow the color contrast guidelines, ensuring all secondary text (#A1A1AA) passes accessibility on the #0A0A0A background.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements: buttons, links, form inputs, and key sections (e.g. data-testid='chat-input').
